remarks: Life at The Classic begins on the 14th floor, where 864 square feet of bright, beautifully proportioned living space awaits. This 1-bedroom, 1-bath residence features a custom walk-in closet and flows effortlessly to a private balcony, delivering stunning views of the Downtown Stamford skyline. Head up to the rooftop sundeck for sweeping Long Island Sound views that truly take your breath away. Situated in the heart of downtown, you're steps from acclaimed restaurants, shopping, entertainment, and UConn with seamless access to public transportation and Metro North just 50 minutes to Grand Central. The Classic elevates the experience further with an impressive suite of amenities: 24-hour concierge and security, heated indoor pool, fitness center, rooftop sundeck, newly renovated dog park, and gas grills. Move-in ready, this is more than a home. It's a lifestyle.
